3. Reset (18,55) to gray

Let me reconsider the game mechanics. Looking at the history:
- Step 55: Clicking (18,55) moved orange from (10,47) to (13,49)
- Step 57: Clicking (13,49) [orange square] didn't move it
- Step 59: Clicking (46,52) [purple square] didn't move it
- Step 38: Clicking (41,49) [purple square] moved orange from (13,34) to (20,48)
Wait, at step 38, clicking the purple square moved the ORANGE square. This is interesting. Let me check if clicking the orange square moves the purple square.
Actually, looking at step 46: Clicking purple at (41,49) moved purple to (44,51). So clicking the purple square moved the purple square, not the orange square.
Let me re-examine step 38:
Step 37: Orange at (13,34), purple at (41,49)
Step 38: Clicked (41,49) [purple square] → Orange moved to (20,48), purple stayed at (41,49)
So clicking the purple square at (41,49) moved the orange square. But at step 46, clicking the purple square at (41,49) moved the purple square to (44,51).
The difference is that at step 38, the purple square was at (41,49) and clicking it moved the orange square. At step 46, the purple square was also at (41,49) and clicking it moved the purple square.
Wait, let me check step 38 more carefully:

Step 38: G(10,48)=22, O(20,48)=20, W(35,45)=12, p(41,49)=20, G(48,54)=12

Step 46: G(9,50)=6, O(10,47)=21, G(14,47)=8, W(35,45)=12, p(41,49)=20, G(48,54)=12
Step 46 result: G(9,50)=6, O(10,47)=21, G(14,47)=8, W(35,45)=12, p(44,51)=20, W(41,49)=10, G(48,54)=12
So clicking (41,49) at step 46 moved purple from (41,49) to (44,51) and converted (41,49) to white. The orange square stayed at (10,47).
The difference between step 38 and step 46 is that at step 38, (35,45) was gray and became white, while at step 46, (35,45) was already white.
So the rule seems to be:
- Clicking a square moves it to the next gray diamond in its trail
- If there are no gray diamonds left in the trail, clicking the square does nothing (or moves the other square?)
Wait, at step 38, clicking the purple square moved the orange square. This is strange. Let me look more carefully.
At step 38, the purple square was at (41,49). The gray diamonds were (10,48), (35,45), and (48,54). The orange square was at (13,34).
After clicking (41,49), the orange square moved to (20,48) and (35,45) became white.
So clicking the purple square at (41,49) caused the orange square to move to (20,48), which is near (35,45). This suggests that clicking the purple square activated the orange square's trail.
Actually, I think I need to reconsider. Maybe the squares share a trail or the trails are connected.
Let me look at the initial state again:
- Orange square at (12,24)
- Purple square at (41,49)
- Gray diamonds at (9,49), (21,8), (35,45), (48,54)
- White ring at (6,17)
The orange square's trail seems to go: (6,17) → (12,24) → ... → (9,49)
The purple square's trail seems to go: (21,8) → (35,45) → (41,49) → (48,54)
But these trails seem to overlap or connect.
